integrity: The threshold equation is prior work; the new claim is the quadratic onset coefficient and the square-root convex-envelope contact law. Numerical evaluations only corroborate the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic is local as the channel parameter approaches the single-use threshold from below.
No multi-use private-information or private-capacity asymptotic is claimed.
The result is restricted to the one-parameter hybrid BSC/BPC line.
title: Quadratic onset of single-use private information at the hybrid BSC/BPC threshold
